visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy brown hair wearing a brown t-shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table, holding a silver tablet and speaking with high energy and exaggerated facial expressions. A black and white ChatGPT logo is fixed in the upper left corner. (2) The screen transitions to a dark grey background displaying a digital text message in Chinese. Below it, an AI-generated image of a caramel pudding in a cozy, dimly lit cafe appears. The man's face is seen in a circular floating frame at the bottom, laughing. (3) The sequence progresses as the man interacts with the tablet, showing increasingly elaborate AI-generated pudding images. One features a gold-wrapped pudding in a grand, chandelier-lit palace with waiters in the background. Another shows a glowing, cosmic-themed pudding surrounded by planets and a black hole in space. (4) The visual style shifts to a warm, painterly AI illustration showing an elderly woman serving a simple pudding to a young boy in a rustic kitchen with soft, warm lighting. (5) A rapid montage of real-life photographs flashes across the screen, showing the man with his mother, posing with friends holding a YouTube creator award, and a group of people sitting around a large dining table in a brightly lit indoor space. (6) The man returns to the center frame, holding a small plush yellow monkey and a real, physically present pudding. He smiles broadly and laughs, looking directly at the camera in a well-lit studio environment.

(4) [Slogan]: 我是要布丁貴!!!. [Variety]: 一直在杯飾或裝潢作文章. (5) [Subtitle]: 再貴一點!!超越世上所有的財富...買不起. (6) [Subtitle]: 給我一顆只有法力強大神靈吃得起的布丁... (7) [Variety]: 我覺得不行 一定要突破天際. [Slogan]: 怎麼像鮮奶油蛋糕. (8) [Subtitle]: 突破所有限制!更瘋狂! (9) [Slogan]: 這好像鷹眼 & 黑寡婦 為了找寶石去的星球. (10) [Subtitle]: 現在，給我一個無價的布丁. (11) [Slogan]: 這就是最無價的布丁. [Variety]: (已經跟布丁沒關係了). (12) [Slogan]: #厭世甜點店. [Subtitle]: 無價の布丁 (無數次嘗試的結晶).

It uses this comedic hook to transition into a heartwarming message about real-life connections, concluding that the 'priceless' pudding is the one shared with family and friends.
